title: Figma Plugin Phase 6 - Magic Numbers Audit Remediation
overview: Address remaining magic numbers identified in comprehensive audit. Phase 5 centralized major constants, but ~40% of generators still have hardcoded values that need remediation for full Figma-code sync capability.

context.problem: Audit revealed scattered magic numbers across generators: section positioning (100, 50), disabled opacity (0.5), label vertical offsets (4, 8, 12), hardcoded RGB colors, and font sizes/weights not using centralized constants.
context.current_state: Phase 5 added SHADOWS, GRID_LAYOUT, FALLBACK_VALUES to shared.ts. However, generators still contain: (1) hardcoded section positioning, (2) scattered opacity values, (3) inconsistent label offsets, (4) hardcoded RGB placeholder colors, (5) typography values not using FALLBACK_VALUES.
context.why_now: Phase 5 (initial magic number elimination) is COMPLETE. This phase addresses remaining issues from comprehensive audit to achieve full sync capability.

primary: Add SECTION_LAYOUT constants for section positioning (startX, startY, modeGap)
Add OPACITY constants for disabled states and backdrops
Add COLORS constants for placeholder RGB values
Refactor high-risk files: dialog.ts, icon-utils.ts, input.ts
Ensure icon-utils.ts ICON_SIZE_MAP derives from registry or shared constants
metrics: All placeholder colors use COLORS constants

functional.title: Add SECTION_LAYOUT Constants
functional.description: Centralize section positioning values used across all generators
acceptance: Add SECTION_LAYOUT to shared.ts with startX: 100, startY: 100, modeGap: 50
All generators use SECTION_LAYOUT instead of hardcoded 100/50
Tests validate section positioning uses constants

functional.title: Add OPACITY Constants
functional.description: Centralize opacity values for disabled states and backdrops
acceptance: Add OPACITY to shared.ts with disabled: 0.5, backdrop: 0.8
All generators use OPACITY.disabled instead of hardcoded 0.5

functional.title: Add COLORS Constants
acceptance: Add COLORS to shared.ts with placeholder gray and fallback white
icon-utils.ts uses COLORS instead of hardcoded RGB objects
dialog.ts uses COLORS instead of hardcoded RGB objects

functional.title: Extend GRID_LAYOUT with labelVerticalOffset
functional.description: Add label vertical centering offsets to GRID_LAYOUT
acceptance: Add labelVerticalOffset to GRID_LAYOUT with sm: 4, md: 8, lg: 12
Generators use GRID_LAYOUT.labelVerticalOffset instead of hardcoded values
Consistent offset selection based on component size

functional.title: Refactor dialog.ts Magic Numbers
functional.description: Replace remaining hardcoded values in dialog.ts with shared constants
acceptance: All font sizes use FALLBACK_VALUES or derive from registry
All padding/gap values use FALLBACK_VALUES or parse from registry
Button dimensions in dialog use Button registry values where possible

functional.title: Refactor icon-utils.ts Magic Numbers
functional.description: Replace hardcoded values in icon-utils.ts with shared constants
acceptance: ICON_SIZE_MAP derived from registry or uses FALLBACK_VALUES.iconSize

functional.title: Refactor input.ts Magic Numbers
functional.description: Replace hardcoded values in input.ts with shared constants
acceptance: Width map documented as generator-specific layout helper
itemSpacing values use SPACING or FALLBACK_VALUES.gap

functional.title: Update Remaining Generators
functional.description: Apply constants to all remaining generators with hardcoded values

functional.title: Add Enforcement Tests
functional.description: Extend drift-detection.test.ts to catch new magic number patterns
acceptance: Test fails if generator has hardcoded section positioning (100, 50)
Test fails if generator has hardcoded opacity (0.5)
Test warns if generator has hardcoded RGB color objects

functional.title: Final Verification
functional.description: Comprehensive verification that all magic numbers are addressed
acceptance: Run audit script to verify no remaining magic numbers

non_functional.title: Backward Compatibility
non_functional.description: All existing tests must pass without breaking changes
acceptance: No visual changes to generated Figma components
